ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the visible surface area consists of approximately 95% low-intensity (black) pixels with roughly 5% high-intensity (white) pixel clusters and linear features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a contiguous low-intensity region. High-intensity geometric blobs are localized at: (1) the far-left distal tip as an irregular cluster; (2) the far-right distal tip as a thin marginal band; (3) the central-inner left lobe as a diagonal linear streak; (4) a sparse point-spread distribution of high-intensity pixels across the lower-half of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate aperture of 85 degrees and a vertical depth occupying roughly 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregularity across the continuous boundary. The left lobe features deep, jagged rectangular and triangular indentations. The right lobe exhibits a higher frequency of lower-amplitude saw-tooth serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex upward curvature originating from the median notch, terminating in sharp lateral points at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible cluster of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groupings on the extreme left margin. Small, isolated circular white spots are scattered on the distal right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent 45-degree diagonal high-intensity streak on the medial left lobe. Multiple lower-contrast, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the central and distal right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and jagged profile along the entire superior boundary. One significant rectangular indentation is present on the medial-superior edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white, raised textured protrusion cluster on the extreme leftmost lateral margin.
